meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划拆成多路并行执行,并留下可核对的证据记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果已把开发计划写成文档,想让它自动并行跑完并留下执行痕迹
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan in parallel tracks and leave an evidence trail you can check
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your dev plan is already written down and you want it executed in parallel with a traceable record

howto.what: Claude 会变成编排者:自己不改代码,而是选中一份写好的 ulw-plan 计划,把每个复选框拆成原子子任务派给并行子代理,自己只负责选计划、派活、判定结果并记录证据,直到所有顶层复选框完成。
howto.when: 当你说出 “ulw-execute”,或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划时触发;若没有可选计划,它会先调用 ulw-plan 生成计划再继续。

say.note: 选中该计划并开始执行
按计划拆任务并派发给子代理
每个阶段的工作区交付成一个 PR

howto.what_en: Claude stops implementing: it picks a written ulw-plan, splits each checkbox into atomic sub-tasks, dispatches them to parallel subagents, and only tracks state, verdicts and evidence until every top-level checkbox is done.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "ulw-execute" or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans; if no plan exists, it first invokes ulw-plan to create one.

say_en.note: Selects the plan and starts execution
Splits it into tasks and dispatches subagents
Delivers each phase's worktree as a PR
